summary: Lookout listed in Appling County, Georgia, on a Georgia tower list; no other source found on its history or present state.

evidence.supports: listed as Tenmile Lookout Tower, Appling County, 186 ft elevation
second entry 'tenmile old' at 185 ft with datasheet BS1563

notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms.us Georgia list, whose header reads 'google map revised Tue Mar 22 07:15:01 2016'. Two web searches turned up no source on a tower by this name. Not on the NHLR Georgia list (29 entries) or the FFLOS Georgia list (2 sites), so no register event. No build date, staffing, fires, fate, or present condition found. The roughly 82 m distance to tenmile old is computed from the listed coordinates. The name 'old' is the list's own; no source says which tower came first. Story is shorter than the usual minimum because nothing else describes the site. Worth checking with the Georgia Forestry Commission.
